notes.title: Update notes for July 1st | v0.0.3
notes.content:
What's new for today?

- Added multiplayer regions to fix a major issue when multiple players were not able to connect to the same game.
- Added post-processing to make everything look prettier.

A major update is coming soon!

Thank you for your support, and have fun!

notes.title: June Game Status Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a long time since the last update, but I want to let everyone know that the work on a new huge update is in progress. A lot of work has been done, and hopefully we will be done with it by the end of July 2024. This update will include some minor fixes and updates, plus we will add a single-player story mode, which will introduce a lot of new game mechanics.

We understand that the current game mode is pretty repetitious and does not have that many game mechanics, so we hope we will be able to fix this situation by introducing a single-player story mode.

Stay tuned for more news, and if you would like to check the dev progress in more detail and see some in-game screenshots, make sure to join our Discord server.

Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: What to expect from the next updates?
notes.content:
Dear gamers and our supporters,

We are happy to share a sneak peek into the exciting updates coming your way for Warehouse Inc! We've been listening closely to your feedback and suggestions, and we're dedicated to making your gaming experience even more enjoyable. Here's a glimpse of what's in store for the future:

- Steam Achievements: Prove your skills and showcase your accomplishments with a brand new set of Steam Achievements. Can you collect them all?
- Steam Cloud Saving: Seamlessly sync your progress across devices with Steam Cloud Saving, ensuring you never lose your hard-earned achievements and progress.
- Game Stats: Detailed statistics tracking. Analyze your performance, refine your strategies, and dominate the world of logistics.
- 100 Levels for Speed Delivery Mode: Get ready for the ultimate challenge as we expand the Speed Delivery mode with a crazy 100 levels! How fast can you deliver?
- Gamepad Support + Steam Deck Compatibility: Full gamepad support. Plus, get ready to take your gaming on the go with seamless compatibility for the Steam Deck.
- Relaxed Mode with a Storyline: New Relaxed Mode, complete with a captivating storyline to accompany your gameplay. Stay tuned for more details, as we are currently working on this part!

We're committed to delivering a great gaming experience, and these updates are just the beginning. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more announcements, and have fun!

* If you encounter any bugs, would like to bring new ideas or suggestions on how to improve some parts of gameplay, please let us know in our Discord channel!

notes.title: Warehouse Inc - Early Access Release!
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting News! 🎉

Attention, fellow gamers and enthusiasts! We are thrilled to announce the early access release of "Warehouse Inc" - your passport to a thrilling world of logistics, strategy, and organization!

📦 About "Warehouse Inc" 📦
In this immersive simulation game, you step into the shoes of a warehouse employee by organizing, sorting and delivering shipments. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

🚀 Early Access Benefits 🚀
As an early access player, you'll have the exclusive opportunity to shape the future of "Warehouse Inc." Your feedback, suggestions, and insights will directly influence the game's development, making this journey truly collaborative and rewarding.

💼 Join the Community 💼
Don't forget to join our Discord server to see all latest news and stay on top of the development process, chat with other members, suggest new improvements and help fix bugs. We would like to make this game interesting for our players, and we are closely listening to your feedback.

🔗 Get Involved! 🔗
Ready to dive into the world of "Warehouse Inc"? Grab your hard hat and join us on this thrilling journey! Purchase your early access copy now on Steam, and let's build the warehouse empire of your dreams, one shipment at a time.

Thank you for supporting us and have fun!

notes.title: Exciting News! "Warehouse Inc" Coming to Early Access on April 30th
notes.content:
Attention all gamers! Get ready to dive into the captivating world of logistics and management with our upcoming release: "Warehouse Inc"! We're thrilled to announce that the Early Access version of our game will be available starting April 30th, 2024.

In "Warehouse Inc," you'll step into the shoes of a warehouse worker aiming to build and manage a hundreds of different packages. It is time to receive, scan, organize and deliver!

Early Access means you'll have the opportunity to experience the game firsthand before its full launch, providing valuable feedback that will help us enhance and refine the gameplay experience. Your input will be instrumental in shaping the final version of "Warehouse Inc," so join us on this exciting journey and be a part of our development process!

Mark your calendars for April 30th, 2024, and get ready to embark on an epic warehouse adventure! Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and exclusive content as we count down to the Early Access launch of "Warehouse Inc"!

Prepare to build, manage, and conquer – only at "Warehouse Inc"! See you in the warehouse!
